description: Poll one order's LIVE status at CryptoRefills and fold it into the local log: returns the `phase`, a `terminal` flag (stop polling once true), and the `delivery` — the redemption code or URL once the order reaches 'delivered'. Use after wallet_buy_giftcard to retrieve the gift card. Read-only, no config gate, moves no money.
name: wallet_get_giftcard_order_status

kind.description: url = visit the link; code = enter the code; none = not delivered yet.

value.description: The redemption code or URL; null until delivered.

delivery.description: The redemption code/URL once delivered; null otherwise.

phase.description: delivered | expired | canceled | manual | paid | awaiting_payment.

terminal.description: true when the order reached a final state (stop polling).

title: Get live gift-card order status
